molecules.name: Leucine
molecules.role: Primary activator of mTORC1 and muscle protein synthesis. Must reach 2-3g threshold per meal for maximal MPS stimulation.

molecules.name: mTORC1 (mechanistic Target of Rapamycin Complex 1)
molecules.label_th: mTORC1 — สวิตช์สร้างกล้ามเนื้อ
molecules.role: Master anabolic switch in skeletal muscle. Activated by leucine, insulin, and mechanical tension. Drives muscle protein synthesis by phosphorylating p70S6K and 4E-BP1.

molecules.name: Creatine Monohydrate
molecules.label_th: ครีเอทีน โมโนไฮเดรต
molecules.role: Precursor to phosphocreatine (PCr). Increases PCr pool in muscle by 20-40%, enabling rapid ATP regeneration during high-intensity exercise. Most studied ergogenic supplement.

molecules.name: Phosphocreatine (PCr)
molecules.label_th: ฟอสโฟครีเอทีน
molecules.role: Rapidly donates phosphate to ADP to regenerate ATP during maximal efforts (0-10 seconds). Acts as immediate energy buffer in skeletal muscle.

molecules.name: Beta-Hydroxy Beta-Methylbutyrate (HMB)
molecules.label_th: HMB — เบต้า-ไฮดรอกซี เบต้า-เมทิลบิวทีเรต
molecules.role: Metabolite of leucine (~5%). Inhibits ubiquitin-proteasome pathway (muscle protein breakdown), activates mTORC1, inhibits caspase-3 apoptosis. Particularly effective in catabolic states.

molecules.name: Essential Amino Acids (EAA)
molecules.label_th: กรดอะมิโนจำเป็น (EAA)
molecules.role: The 9 amino acids the body cannot synthesize: leucine, isoleucine, valine, histidine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan. All required for complete muscle protein synthesis.

molecules.name: Branched-Chain Amino Acids (BCAA)
molecules.label_th: กรดอะมิโนโซ่กิ่ง (BCAA)
molecules.role: Leucine, isoleucine, valine. BCAA can transiently activate mTORC1 via leucine but cannot independently drive complete MPS without the remaining 6 EAAs.

molecules.name: Growth Hormone (GH / Somatotropin)
molecules.label_th: ฮอร์โมนการเจริญเติบโต (GH)
molecules.role: 70-75% of daily GH secreted during slow-wave sleep. Stimulates IGF-1 production which drives MPS and inhibits proteolysis. Declines with age — key link between sleep quality and muscle health.

molecules.name: Whey Protein
molecules.label_th: เวย์โปรตีน
molecules.role: Fast-digesting complete protein with high leucine content (~10-11%). Highest PDCAAS/DIAAS score among common proteins. Optimal for post-exercise MPS stimulation.

molecules.name: Casein Protein
molecules.label_th: เคซีนโปรตีน
molecules.role: Slow-digesting protein forming a gel in the stomach. Provides sustained amino acid release over 5-7 hours. Ideal for pre-sleep consumption to fuel overnight MPS.

molecules.name: Collagen Peptides
molecules.label_th: คอลลาเจนเปปไทด์
molecules.role: Hydrolyzed collagen providing proline, hydroxyproline, glycine. Supports collagen synthesis in tendons, ligaments, and cartilage when combined with Vitamin C before exercise. Does NOT directly stimulate muscle protein synthesis.
